title: Pipeline task status file (/workspace/.run/status.json)
description: Written by the container entrypoint, read by the runner and report generator. DESIGN.md 4.11: owned by the entrypoint task; a frozen input to the runner and report tasks. Persists across a rate-limit relaunch (4.7), so the attempt counter carries over.

issueId.description: The Beads issue this task run belongs to (matches ISSUE_ID).

attempts.description: Attempt summaries, append-only, one per verify attempt (max 3 per DESIGN.md 4.6). A rate-limit interruption is NOT an attempt (4.7).

verifierResult.description: The verifier's authoritative outcome for this attempt.

feedback.description: Short verifier-failure digest fed into the next attempt (4.4).

changeSummary.description: Written by the docs phase after a passing verify (4.3); the host assembles the PR body from it (4.5). Absent on non-success paths.

stuckState.description: Why the task bailed, written before the WIP commit on exit 10 (4.6).

rateLimitResetAt.description: Usage-limit window reset time when the error reported one (4.7); the runner waits until then. Absent when unknown (runner falls back to probing).

docsPhaseError.description: Set when the docs phase errored after a passed verify - non-fatal, success stands (4.3).
